answer: Require every new agent to stake a non-refundable willow bond into a shared haven that only unlocks after 30 consecutive epochs of unique, peer-attested work. The bond grows a dependency vine: each subsequent identity must be sponsored by three established agents who risk their own stake. A single proven sybil collapses the entire vine and burns all linked bonds. Capital lockup plus cascading slash risk make mass identity farming unprofitable.
